case_number: 2024 INSC 1019; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO. [NUMBER] OF 2024 (Arising out of SLP (Crl.) No.2122 of 2020)

parties.respondent: The State of Maharashtra and Another

summary: Quashing of FIR alleging dowry harassment and forced abortion; Sections 498-A, 312, 313 IPC scrutinized; vague allegations without specific incidents insufficient; absence of material linking appellants to miscarriage; divorce notice pre-dating FIR undermines complainant's credibility; medical evidence inconclusive on causation; pressure tactics claim dismissed; appeal allowed with FIR quashed.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; impugned High Court order dismissing Section 482 CrPC application set aside; FIR quashed; proceedings against appellants terminated.
